title: Totem of the Storm
description: Build a Storm Totem, summon lightning, boost yourself and your crops!
body:
# Totem of the Storm ⚡

**This is my first mod! I'm just learning Java and Minecraft modding. Please don't judge too harshly!**

---

## 🎓 What is this?

This mod adds a **Storm Totem** — a structure that summons lightning and gives buffs when activated. Made by following tutorials, trial and error, with tons of mistakes along the way.

---

## ⚠️ Honest Warning

- 🎨 **Textures are bad** — I'm not an artist, drew them myself + some AI help
- 🐛 **There may be bugs** — this is my first project, barely tested
- 💻 **Code isn't perfect** — I'm learning, feedback is welcome in Issues
- 🔧 **Limited features** — the mod is simple, but it works (I think)

---

## ⚡ What the mod does

- Build a totem from 3 blocks (2 Storm Blocks + 1 Rod)
- Activate with Storm Flint
- Lightning, particles, thunder sound
- Player gets Speed and Jump Boost
- Nearby crops instantly grow
- Animals glow and drop experience

---

## 🛠️ Crafting

| Item | Ingredients |
|------|-------------|
| Charged Copper Ingot | Copper + Redstone + Glowstone Dust |
| Storm Infused Block | Charged Ingots + Smooth Stone |
| Storm Rod | Charged Ingots + Storm Block |
| Storm Dust | Glowstone Dust + Redstone + Gunpowder |
| Storm Flint | Storm Dust + Charged Ingots + Flint & Steel |

---

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Loader:** Forge
- **Fabric:** maybe later, when I figure it out

---

## 🙏 From the author

I'm just starting my modding journey. This mod is my first creation, made over a few days with the help of an AI friend and lots of Googling. If you downloaded this — thank you! If you find a bug — let me know, I'll try to fix it. If you're an experienced modder — please don't roast my code too hard 😅

Planned:
- [ ] Better textures
- [ ] Fabric version
- [ ] More content
- [ ] Bug fixes

*Thanks for stopping by! Learning is part of the process.* 💙
